title.zh: 【花旗代币服务拓展至日本和阿联酋】
title.en: 【花旗代币服务拓展至日本和阿联酋】

current_state.zh: Citi Token Services has expanded to Japan and the UAE, letting clients with accounts in those markets move funds between their own accounts or to other Citi Token Services clients 24/7, free of cut-off times and holidays, bringing the service's footprint to the US, Ireland, Hong Kong, Singapore, the UK, Japan, and the UAE.
current_state.en: Citi Token Services has expanded to Japan and the UAE, letting clients with accounts in those markets move funds between their own accounts or to other Citi Token Services clients 24/7, free of cut-off times and holidays, bringing the service's footprint to the US, Ireland, Hong Kong, Singapore, the UK, Japan, and the UAE.
